paragraphs.text:
You  crawl  up  on  the  beach,  your  body  aching  from  the 
punishing high dive. It takes you a long time to catch your 
breath. Surely your captors must think you have been killed 
by the terrifying leap.

You may attempt a First Aid roll; if you succeed, restore 1D3 hit 
points. Then, go to 365.
